title: THE DOOR THAT OPENS TO TOMORROW
premise: A lonely man sees a door to tomorrow, sees his future self still alone, and sends one honest message.

scenes.title: Alone
scenes.action: He sits alone at his desk.

scenes.title: Something strange
scenes.action: A golden outline becomes a teal door.

scenes.title: Curiosity
scenes.action: He walks toward the door with planted steps.

scenes.title: Discovery
scenes.action: He grips the handle and opens the door.

scenes.title: Tomorrow
scenes.action: The same room appears in morning light.

scenes.title: The warning
scenes.action: His future self is still alone beside an unsent message.

scenes.title: The choice
scenes.action: He looks at his phone and decides.

scenes.title: A small action
scenes.action: He types and sends Hey. I miss you.
